findings.evidence: `nl -ba TauCeti/Geometry/Diffeomorphism/Prod.lean` shows lines 136-142 document `relativeProdHom_apply_apply` as a pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom`, but line 141 states `Prod.map ... x = ...`; lines 129-133 are the separate forgetting lemma for `relativeProdHom`.
findings.fix: Restate it with `relativeProdHom` on the left, e.g. `((relativeProdHom (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) s t p : (M × N) ≃ₘ^n⟮I.prod J, I.prod J⟯ M × N) x) = ((p.1 : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I,I⟯ M) x.1, (p.2 : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J,J⟯ N) x.2)`.
findings.issue: `relativeProdHom_apply_apply` is named and documented as the pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom`, but its left side is only `Prod.map ... x`, so it proves the definitional behavior of `Prod.map` and will not directly rewrite `(relativeProdHom s t p) x`.

summary: The relative product pointwise API is still mis-formalized: the advertised theorem does not state a formula for applying `relativeProdHom`.
